name: a question and answer bubble exchange over the scene
looks: A speech bubble in a plain outline style pops in above the shopfront asking a question, then a second bubble in the brand's filled colour pops in lower, from the mascot, answering with a specific detail, while the camera slowly pushes in.
build: dual-voice-type's two-voice contrast, applied to bubbles instead of text styles: the question bubble is an outline/light style, the answer bubble is solid-filled in the accent colour, each popping in on a quick scale-and-settle (back.out) a beat apart.
sound: A soft pop per bubble, a light camera-push whoosh.
prompt: Pop in a plain question bubble from one voice, then a second, visually distinct bubble from the product's own voice answering with a specific, concrete detail. Give the two bubbles different styles (outline vs filled) so who is asking and who is answering is clear at a glance.
